title: Formalizing the Reduced Mahler 3/2 Dynamical System in Lean 4: Exact 1D Slack Reduction, Constructive Coasting Survivors, Conditional Finiteness Theorems, and Certified Transcendence Barriers
description: A 142-file, sorry-free Lean 4.19.0 + Mathlib v4.19.0 formalization of the reduced Mahler 3/2 dynamical system (Z-numbers), developed by Joshua Coon with Astra and Argon AI assistance via GitHub Copilot. Proves the exact 1D minSlack dynamical reduction, the 5-way general Mahler conjecture equivalence with signed integer margin failure on positive stabilized seed branches and unbounded growth of least surviving positive seeds B(N), certified global lower bound B(29) >= 4096, quantitative extensions of Dubickas (2008/2009) upgrading Sturmian carry words to the sharp log(2)/log(3/2) complexity threshold and establishing explicit O(log xi) escape bounds for [0,1/5)U[4/5,1), [1/6, 13/24), and Dubickas's 2008 closed union [8/39, 18/39]U[21/39, 31/39] of length 20/39 > 1/2, unconditional exclusions of arbitrary two-letter mechanical/Sturmian chains, non-stationary oscillating-epoch words, Thue-Morse and Period-Doubling encodings, rapid-growth odd-quotient descent, the 113-step survival and 114-step death of the 55-bit seed 29871555608238677, and certified Diophantine barrier analyses.
